collection.description: A rare Fourpetal Maple's scent draws night pollinators, and perfumers want its flowers.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A rare Fourpetal Maple releases an extraordinary scent that attracts nocturnal pollinators. Perfumers want to strip its flowers.

choices.label: Create a mixed or herbal blend

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The scent is faint but the pollinators continue visiting.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The perfume succeeds; the botanist monitors seed production.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The fragrance is abundant now but future fruiting may suffer.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The imitation is imperfect yet becomes popular.
